item.title: Premium Clean Achieves Recertification for Quality and Environmental Management Systems
item.description: BUSINESS Auckland, New Zealand – Premium Clean has successfully recertified both its quality and environmental management systems. TNV assessed the company’s operations and confirmed that Premium Clean meets internationally recognised standards for service quality and environmental responsibility. TNV stands for TÜV NORD.
